description: Service booking platform connecting users with providers. Industry brain defines what is being booked. This core defines how booking works.

relationships: User books an Appointment for a Service with a Provider
Appointment has a Status (pending, confirmed, completed, cancelled, no-show)
User writes a Review about a Provider or Service after Appointment
User can join a WaitList for a fully booked Service or time slot
Package belongs to Provider, bundles multiple Services
Notification belongs to User, triggered by Appointment status changes

mvp.description: Core booking — discover provider, view services, book appointment, manage bookings.
primary_flows: Browse providers → view provider detail → select service → pick date and time → confirm booking → receive confirmation
View upcoming appointments → manage or cancel
Receive reminder notification → view appointment detail
secondary_flows: Search for provider by name or location

interaction_patterns: Calendar picker highlights available dates in accent colour — unavailable greyed out
Time slot grid — available slots as tappable chips, booked slots greyed
Booking confirmation has a 5-second cancel window after submit
Appointment status badge — pending yellow, confirmed green, cancelled red
Add to calendar triggers native calendar integration
Review prompt appears 1 hour after appointment end time
Provider cards show next available slot time — not just availability

scale.description: Multi-location booking platform with staff management, advanced analytics, membership, and white-label support.
primary_flows: Multi-location provider — user selects location → books at that branch
Membership signup → unlocks unlimited or discounted bookings → auto-renews
Provider views advanced analytics → adjusts pricing and availability → optimises revenue
Admin manages all providers → approves listings → resolves disputes → views platform KPIs
Gift card purchase → send to recipient → recipient redeems at checkout
secondary_flows: Dynamic pricing — peak time pricing set by provider
Multi-staff booking — book multiple staff for one appointment
Corporate accounts — company books for employees
Custom booking form fields set by provider
